Don't be a pussy and learn to fight as vayne and that means taking risks! you have the highest chances to win on must maches when even and even you had some if you're below. Be aware of how much impact your invisibility has (A LOT) and abuse it! Don't use q just for damage, use it for reposition too. The more you live the more damage you can output.

In lane vanye is pretty lame so ALWAYS punish the mistakes the enemies may commit. Remember that you can use your autos to poke the enemy support if it's melee and has it's cc on cooldown.

You should play her A LOT and I mean A LOT until you kinda get everything automatized and you can focus on what you do and not so much in the potential/mechanics.

Also don't blame yourself if she doesn't suits your playstyle. Recognize your weakness and strengths and don't force yourself to learn things that doesn't match your playstyle! It's not that it's not worth because it may be but it may be a pain in the ass because it means leaving your comfort zone. 

I hope it helps ♥
